title: Security
description: Who may sign in, on what terms, and how hard it is to guess their way in.

access.heading: Access
access.description: Who can reach this instance, and what they must present to do it.

twoFactor.label: Two-factor requirement
twoFactor.hint: When 2FA is required, users without it are prompted to set it up the next time they sign in.
twoFactor.warning: Applies on next login. Users without 2FA will be sent through setup before they can continue.

optional.label: Optional
optional.description: Users can enable 2FA from their account settings.

privileged.label: Required for admins
privileged.description: Require 2FA for users with elevated permissions.

saved.title: 2FA policy updated
saved.description: The new requirement applies on the next login.

domains.label: Allowed signup domains
domains.hint: Domains new users may self-register with. Leave the list empty to disable self-registration; a single * allows any domain.
domains.empty: No domains listed — self-registration is disabled.
domains.loadFailed: The domain list could not be loaded, so it cannot be edited from here. Reload the page to try again — saving would replace the whole list, and this view does not know what is in it.

saved.title: Signup domains saved
saved.description: New registrations are checked against this list.

error.title: Could not save the signup domains

rateLimit.heading: Sign-in throttling
rateLimit.description: Throttle failed authentication attempts per IP and lock accounts after repeated failures.
rateLimit.loadFailed: The throttling settings could not be loaded, so they cannot be edited from here. Reload the page to try again — the other groups on this page are unaffected.

maxAttempts.label: Max attempts
maxAttempts.description: Failed attempts allowed within the window before triggering throttle or lockout.

windowSeconds.label: Window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: Time window during which failed attempts are counted.

lockoutDurationSeconds.label: Lockout duration (seconds)
lockoutDurationSeconds.description: Base lockout duration when the threshold is reached.

exponentialBackoff.label: Exponential backoff
exponentialBackoff.description: Extend the lockout exponentially on consecutive lockouts.

backoffMultiplier.label: Backoff multiplier
backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to lockout duration when exponential backoff is on.

error.title: Could not save throttling
error.description: Check the values and try again.

policy.heading: Password policy
policy.description: What counts as an acceptable password. Changes apply at the next password validation, not retroactively.
policy.loadFailed: The password policy could not be loaded, so it and the per-role overrides cannot be edited from here. Reload the page to try again — the other groups on this page are unaffected.

minLength.label: Minimum length
minLength.description: Reject passwords shorter than this. Range 8-1024 (NIST 800-63B floor).

maxLength.label: Maximum length
maxLength.description: Reject passwords longer than this. Range 8-1024.

allowAllUnicode.label: Allow all Unicode characters
allowAllUnicode.description: When off, only ASCII printable characters are accepted.

requireUppercase.label: Require an uppercase letter
requireUppercase.description: Reject passwords without at least one uppercase letter.

requireLowercase.label: Require a lowercase letter
requireLowercase.description: Reject passwords without at least one lowercase letter.

requireDigit.label: Require a digit
requireDigit.description: Reject passwords without at least one digit.

requireSpecial.label: Require a special character
requireSpecial.description: Reject passwords without at least one non-alphanumeric character.

checkHIBP.label: Check against HIBP breach database
checkHIBP.description: Reject passwords that have appeared in known breaches.

checkCommonPasswords.label: Reject common passwords
checkCommonPasswords.description: Block passwords from the bundled common-password list.

minZxcvbnScore.label: Minimum zxcvbn score (0-4)
minZxcvbnScore.description: Strength estimator. 0 = very weak, 4 = very strong.

historySize.label: Password history size
historySize.description: Block reuse of the last N passwords. 0 disables history.

rotationDays.label: Forced rotation (days)
rotationDays.description: Force password change after this many days. 0 disables rotation.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.subtitle: Type a candidate password and the server evaluates it against the unsaved values on the left — including HIBP, zxcvbn and the common-password list.
preview.disclosure: Evaluated server-side against the draft policy. The password is sent over TLS and never stored.

errors.PASSWORD_REUSED: Matches one of the last {{historySize}} passwords.

diff.title: Confirm password policy changes
diff.subtitle: These rules apply to every password validated from now on. Review what is changing.

overrides.title: Per-role overrides
overrides.subtitle: Override individual password rules for a role. Anything left inherited follows the policy above.

removed.title: Override removed
removed.description: Role {{role}} now follows the global policy.

saved.title: Override saved
saved.description: Role {{role}} now uses the customized policy.

modal.title: Password overrides for {{role}}
modal.subtitle: Turn a field on to override it; leave it off to inherit from the global policy. Turning every field off removes the override.

savedToast.title: Password policy updated
savedToast.description: New rules apply at the next password validation.

errorToast.title: Could not save the password policy
errorToast.description: Please review the values and try again.
